To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the scaling behavior of the SU(2) screening mass is consistent with dimensional reduction, that the screening mass is well approximated by a single parameter fit on lattices with a lattice spacing of about 0.2 fm, and that the screening mass can be used to determine the temperature of the system with an accuracy of better than 5%.
the screening masses of SU(2) are finite and that they decrease as the inverse of the temperature, in accordance with dimensional reduction.
we can extract physical screening masses from rather coarse lattics and that the physical results are well described by a dimensional reduction ansatz.
